title: Spring Boot CRUD Masterclass via Express.js Mapping
topic: Complete step-by-step guide to building CRUD endpoints in Java Spring Boot by mapping every concept and term to Node.js and Express.js

global_style.art_style: Clean hand-drawn whiteboard explainer illustration style, crisp black ink marker sketches on a bright white whiteboard background, vibrant blue, green, orange, and red marker accents, neat hand-lettered text labels and clean readable code snippets, simple icons, boxes, and directional arrows, bright even lighting, 16:9 widescreen framing.
global_style.negative_prompt: dark background, photorealistic, 3D render, blurry, messy overlapping scribbles, garbled unreadable text, watermarks, low contrast
